kind: source-layout simulation, NOT emulator or hardware footage

frames.title: Welcome to Vector CE
frames.caption: Native TI-BASIC workflow for TI-84 Plus CE and CE Python.

frames.title: Choose the session workspace
frames.caption: Back up matrix [J] and the documented variables before starting.

frames.title: Start with an empty vector list
frames.caption: Vectors are loaded only when you enter them. There are no default vectors.

frames.title: Vector 1 / polar input
frames.caption: First enter 3 units pointing along the positive x-axis.

frames.title: Enter magnitude >= 0
frames.caption: The magnitude uses your chosen consistent units.

frames.title: Choose a direction convention
frames.caption: Standard angles are measured counterclockwise from +x.

frames.title: Enter angle in degrees
frames.caption: Zero degrees points east or to the right.

frames.title: Review vector 1
frames.caption: The calculator stores x=3, y=0 and magnitude 3.

frames.title: Vector 2 / component input
frames.caption: Mix input types: add an upward vector using its components.

frames.title: Enter horizontal x
frames.caption: The second vector has no horizontal component.

frames.title: Enter vertical y
frames.caption: Its positive vertical component points north or up.

frames.title: Review vector 2
frames.caption: The second vector is 4 units at 90 degrees.

frames.title: Choose a graph view
frames.caption: Head-to-tail shows the actual order of addition.

frames.title: Head to tail / 3 plus 4
frames.caption: Blue arrows add in sequence. Red joins the origin to the final endpoint.

frames.title: Compare at a common origin
frames.caption: The same two vectors are drawn from one starting point.

frames.title: Step through addition / 0
frames.caption: Start at zero. No vectors have been added yet.

frames.title: Step through addition / 1
frames.caption: Add vector 1: the running resultant is (3,0).

frames.title: Step through addition / 2
frames.caption: Add vector 2: the running resultant is (3,4).

frames.title: Total components
frames.caption: Rx=3 and Ry=4. The stored values retain native precision.

frames.title: Vector 1 components
frames.caption: Vector 1 contributes x=3, y=0.

frames.title: Add the first x component
frames.caption: The running x sum becomes 3.

frames.title: Add the first y component
frames.caption: The running y sum remains 0.

frames.title: Vector 2 components
frames.caption: Vector 2 contributes x=0, y=4.

frames.title: Add the next x component
frames.caption: Add zero: the x total is still 3.

frames.title: Add the next y component
frames.caption: Add four: the y total becomes 4.

frames.title: Resultant magnitude
frames.caption: sqrt(3 squared + 4 squared) = 5 units.

frames.title: Handle the correct quadrant
frames.caption: Axis cases and negative x values have explicit handling.

frames.title: Substitute the components
frames.caption: Use atan(4/3), then apply the appropriate quadrant correction.

frames.title: Resultant direction
frames.caption: 53.13010235 degrees CCW; equivalently north of east.

frames.title: Inspect the resultant triangle
frames.caption: Green x=3 and orange y=4 form a right triangle with hypotenuse R=5.

frames.title: Use a compass description
frames.caption: Example: 24 units at 30 degrees east of north.

frames.title: Start from north
frames.caption: The first reference direction is north, not east.

frames.title: Turn toward east
frames.caption: 30 degrees east of north converts to 60 degrees CCW from +x.

frames.title: Review a compass vector
frames.caption: x=12; y is approximately 20.78460969; magnitude=24.

frames.title: Negative components / quadrant II
frames.caption: A negative x component points west. The direction is 126.86989765 degrees.

frames.title: Opposite vectors cancel
frames.caption: The resultant is zero. Its direction is undefined, not zero degrees.

frames.title: Cancellation / head to tail
frames.caption: The final endpoint returns to the origin.

frames.title: Edit without restarting
frames.caption: An edit replaces the selected vector only after all values are valid.

frames.title: Delete with confirmation
frames.caption: Delete shifts the remaining vectors while keeping their order.

frames.title: Controls are always available
frames.caption: Return to the main menu to review conventions and input limits.
